omission.chore: Notify the restaurant operator when a new website order is placed.
omission.evidenceQuote: I want to build an automated restaurant order notification system using Make.com .
omission.reason: The exclusion relies on absent implementation evidence for triggers and WhatsApp delivery. That may constrain feasibility ratings, but the explicit order-notification request supports examining a bounded prototype using operator-supplied or synthetic orders and a clearly labeled notification step.
